author: KooDaLord
body: I have recently seen goodbye posts locked because the forums aren't a place to post person issues and such. I am 100% against ruling out goodbye posts. If you are leaving the server, and are a forum member, people probably know you, and would like to know when and why you are leaving, not just notice after a month the player is gone. Its not like they harm anyone or anything .-.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
Doesn't mean the thread should be locked.
The idea of a goodbye thread is to inform the community that you're leaving the server.
As upsetting that might be it's the truth.

Someone might spend years on Avicus and then finally call it quits-only to have the thread locked by a Moderator who thinks it's a status update on Facebook or something.

I think all mods need to be 100% clear on how to handle specific threads on the forums. Because unfortunately mistakes were made.
